title: Co-browse — action intent
query: Click the first link on the page
note: Exercises: streaming JSON `{actions:[…]}` suppression by looksLikeActionJson; action normalization (key-first → type-first); done.response as fullText; action timeline rendering.

title: Co-browse — multi-action sequence
query: Fill the search box with 'Zo Computer' and click the search button
note: Exercises: multiple actions (fill + click); sequential action execution; done.response as final summary.

title: Co-browse — read-only intent downgraded
query: Summarize what this page is about
note: Exercises: intent-aware prompt downgrade (detectIntent → shouldDowngradeToJsonDisabled). Even though mode is cobrowse (expectJson:true), the read-only query gets the PLAIN_RESPONSE_HINT instead of ACTION_SCHEMA_COMPACT, so Zo streams plain markdown, not `{actions:[…]}`.

title: Ask — quick question
query: What is the main topic of this page?
note: Exercises: plain-markdown streaming (no action envelope); tier 1 context (visibleText only); concise answer style.

title: Research — deep analysis
query: Research the key claims and evidence on this page
note: Exercises: longer text budget (4000); structured markdown output (headings, citations).

title: Summarize — concise summary
query: Give me a brief summary of this page
note: Exercises: short text budget (2000); bullet or paragraph output.

title: Extract — structured data
query: Extract all navigation links and headings into a table
note: Exercises: tier 2 context (clickable elements with selectors); table/markdown output; expectJson:false so no JSON envelope wrapping.

title: Visual — screenshot description
query: Describe what's visible on the screen
note: Exercises: tier 3 (screenshot context); vision/description output; smallest text budget (1000). Requires screenshot enabled.
